title: Cross-Scenario Controller Parameter Transformation from Real-World Driving Data through Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2610.32719v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems have become increasingly widespread, aiming to support drivers, reduce workload, and improve traffic safety. However, many systems are rarely used because their behavior feels unnatural and does not match individual driving behavior. The growing availability of large-scale, real-world human driving data enables more human-like and driver-individual assistance functions. This paper formulates the adaptation of Adaptive Cruise Control parameters as a driver-individual scenario-to-scenario transport problem, transforming controller parameters from one driving context to another. Using flow matching, we train a generative model to predict the target-scenario behavior of previously unseen drivers from only a few demonstrations in a source scenario. We compare the approach with a linear parameter-shift baseline and evaluate flow-matching variants incorporating driver-consistent coupling, driver embeddings,

translated_title: 通过流匹配从真实世界驾驶数据实现跨场景控制器参数转换
translated_abstract: 高级驾驶辅助系统（ADAS）日益普及，旨在为驾驶员提供支持、降低工作负荷并提升交通安全。然而，许多系统很少被使用，原因在于其行为感觉不自然，与驾驶员个人的驾驶风格不匹配。大规模真实世界人类驾驶数据的日益可得，使得开发更类人化、面向个体驾驶员的辅助功能成为可能。本文将自适应巡航控制（ACC）参数的适配问题形式化为一个面向个体驾驶员的场景到场景的传输问题，即将控制器参数从一种驾驶情境转换到另一种驾驶情境。利用流匹配技术，我们训练了一个生成模型，仅需源场景中的少量演示即可预测未见过的驾驶员在目标场景中的行为。我们将该方法与线性参数偏移基线进行了对比，并评估了融合驾驶员一致性耦合、驾驶员嵌入等机制的流匹配变体。
tldr: 该论文的核心创新是将ACC控制器参数适配形式化为驾驶员个性化的场景间传输问题，利用流匹配生成模型，仅凭少量源场景演示即可为陌生驾驶员预测并生成目标场景下的控制器参数，实现跨驾驶场景的个性化参数转换。
en_tdlr: This paper's key contribution is formulating ACC controller parameter adaptation as a driver-individual scenario-to-scenario transport problem, using a flow-matching generative model to predict unseen drivers' target-scenario behavior from only a few source-scenario demonstrations.
